{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "BarneyChambers",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "tested functional tests and raised three wallet and PSBT issues, which the author addressed"
    },
    {
      "login": "fametrano",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "tested against BIP460 vectors and 35 edge cases; suggested updating vendored test vectors"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:4015169298",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "signrawtransactionwithwallet prematurely reports complete=true on incomplete spends with dummy member witnesses because per-input script verification succeeds on markers",
      "quote": "ProduceSignature and DataFromTransaction then treat that success as complete, so a dummy member looks fully signed.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added tx-level VerifyCISATransaction check in SignTransaction and a wallet test",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4061515159"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4061515159",
      "status_by_quote": "SignTransaction now runs VerifyCISATransaction once all inputs are processed and reports the error on the aggregated inp"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4015199259",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "combinepsbt silently keeps the first half-aggregation signature instead of detecting conflicting signatures across inputs",
      "quote": "Half-agg signatures do not get checked the same way. Merge keeps the first m_cisa_halfagg_sig it sees.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained keeping first is intended per BIP 174/371 and added test showing invalid sigs fail finalization",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4061514910"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4061514910",
      "status_by_quote": "This is intended, halfagg has no signing session so two different signatures for the same input can both be valid and ei"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4015234807",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "FinalizeCISAInputs skipping already-signed inputs can partition inputs into duplicate groups of the same mode that fail consensus",
      "quote": "This skip on already-signed inputs can leave you with two separate groups of the same mode. Consensus then fails the tx with SCRIPT_ERR_CISA_GROUP_INVALID",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated FinalizeCISAInputs to close group once an input has a final witness",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4061514589"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4061514589",
      "status_by_quote": "The finalizer should treat a group as closed once any input of that mode has a final witness and I have changed Finalize"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6395236778",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "update vendored cisa_consensus_vectors.json to match the updated BIP copy",
      "quote": "The vendored cisa_consensus_vectors.json is older than the BIP's copy. Its marker-undefined case is optout-sighash-undefined there, with the same transaction, now an opted-out signature with an undefi",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated the vendored vectors in the latest push",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6607388910"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6607388910",
      "status_by_quote": "Updated in the latest push."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:6395236778",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "the consensus code agrees with BIP460's vectors and with 35 extra edge cases, checked against maintained libraries",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "tested",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Updated c:6395236778 to fixed following fjahr's push and reply in c:6607388910 updating the vendored test vectors. PR is waiting on reviewer fametrano to check the update.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "fametrano to check the updated vendored test vectors",
      "id": "c:6607388910"
    }
  ]
}
